==English==

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*mey- (small)}}
{{ety|en|:lbor|la:minimum|text=+|tree=1|nodot=1}}, neuter form of {{m|la|minimus|t=least, smallest}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈmɪnɪməm/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈmɪnəməm/|a=GA}}
* {{audio|en|En-us-minimum.ogg|a=GA}}
* {{hyphenation|en|min|i|mum}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|mimimums|minima}}

# The [[lowest]] [[limit]].
#: {{ux|en|We prefer candidates with a '''minimum''' of 4 years experience in the field.}}
#: {{ux|en|We need a '''minimum''' of three staff members on duty at all times.}}
# The [[smallest]] [[amount]].
#: {{ux|en|He always tries to get away with doing the '''minimum'''.}}
#: {{ux|en|Please keep noise to a '''minimum''' after 11 o'clock}}
#* {{RQ:Time|title=Kate Winslet's ''Mare of Easttown'' Is the Rare Crime Drama That Cares About Its Characters|author=Judy Berman|date=April 16 2021|passage=Realism might be the hardest aesthetic to do well. The performances have to be genuinely moving and the setting vividly evoked; bonkers twists must be kept to a '''minimum'''.|url=https://time.com/5953833/mare-of-easttown-review/|accessdate=16 April 2021|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20210416144622/https://time.com/5953833/mare-of-easttown-review/|archivedate=16 April 2021}}
# {{lb|en|astronomy}} A period of minimum [[brightness]] or [[energy]] [[intensity]] (of a [[star]]).
#: {{ux|en|The Maunder '''minimum''' of the Sun reportedly corresponded to a period of great cold on Earth.}}
# {{lb|en|analysis}} A [[lower bound]] of a set which is also an element of that set.
# {{lb|en|statistics}} The smallest member of a [[batch]] or [[sample]] or the lower bound of a [[probability distribution]].

====Usage notes====
* {{m|en|minima|Minima}} is still the more frequently used plural for the senses in published technical works, but ''minimums'' is increasing in its frequency.

* {{l|en|maximum}}
